name: top-down-letters
title: Top-Down Letters
description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time, with no blur: a sharp, graphic title.
useWhen: A single uppercase word or short acronym should enter with structural weight, each letter landing like a stamp.
The scene calls for a sharp, graphic title card where the sequential drop reinforces the rhythm of the word.
avoidWhen: The text is more than about 8 characters: use staggered-fade-up for longer phrases.
You want blur or softness on entry: use soft-blur-in.
The letters should rise from below: use bottom-up-letters.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word or short acronym that drops in.

variables.label: Stagger delay
variables.description: Frames (30 per second) between one letter and the next.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far above its place each letter starts.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
